posts.title: Stalker
posts.synopsis: A guide leads a writer and a scientist through the Zone, a forbidden landscape where a room is said to grant your deepest wish.

posts.title: I Am Not Your Negro
posts.synopsis: Based on Baldwin's unfinished manuscript Remember This House - a stirring, personal account of the lives and deaths of his friends Medgar Evers, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King Jr. - acclaimed director Raoul Peck creates a meditation on what it means to be Black in the United States, using meticulously assembled archival footage and driven by stirring voiceover narration from Samuel L. Jackson.
